Conceded: the bear correctly notes that profit growth contracted by -3% [E15] and that return on assets sits at 0% against the sector benchmark [E8], which explains the near-term earnings deceleration [E45]. However, the market is recognizing concrete operational improvements that offset these lagging bottom-line figures, specifically quarterly operating margins expanding to 20% in March 2026 compared to 19% in the year-ago quarter [E20]. Furthermore, the company benefits from strong sector tailwinds where the median profit growth runs at 22.0% [E49], positioning Ideal Technoplast to successfully convert its multi-year sales momentum [E43] into earnings realization.
